<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { RatingRoot, type RatingRootEmits, type RatingRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<RatingRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<RatingRootEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Rating items. Receives the current value and the item indexes.
   */
  default?: (props: { modelValue: number | undefined; items: number[] }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <RatingRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="rating"
    class="sigma-ui-rating"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </RatingRoot>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-rating {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: calc(var(--spacing) * 1);
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { RatingItem, type RatingItemProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<RatingItemProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Indicators for this item. Receives the step values that make up the item.
   */
  default?: (props: { steps: number[] }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <RatingItem
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="rating-item"
    class="sigma-ui-rating-item"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </RatingItem>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-rating-item {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { RatingItemIndicator, type RatingItemIndicatorProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<RatingItemIndicatorProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <RatingItemIndicator
    data-slot="rating-item-indicator"
    class="sigma-ui-rating-indicator"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </RatingItemIndicator>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-rating-indicator {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-rating-indicator[data-state="active"] {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.sigma-ui-rating-indicator[data-state="active"] svg {
  fill: var(--accent);
}
</style>
